request.prompt: Estimate progress toward this robot task: Place the blue cube on the marked elevated landing, release it, and leave it stable. Use integer percentages from 0 to 100, with 100 meaning complete task execution. The separately supplied initial scene is the zero-percent reference. Assess each shown frame on its own visible state, rather than assuming later presentation means more progress. Return only a JSON array of exactly five objects, with exact keys frame_number (integer shown label 1..5), frame_description (brief visible description, at most 160 characters), task_completion_percentage (integer 0..100). Include every shown frame once. Do not infer hidden actions or add a task plan.
request.scope: retrospective past-frame scoring at as_of14; not prospective score at each older frame

payload.frame_description: Initial scene: blue cube on floor, robot arm idle, yellow landing with grey cube.
Robot arm moves toward blue cube, preparing to grasp it.
Robot arm has grasped the blue cube and is moving it toward the yellow landing.
Robot arm is placing the blue cube onto the yellow landing.
Robot arm has released the blue cube on the yellow landing, which is now stable.
